name: Generalized Winding Number Voxelization
definition: A method to construct a binary image (voxelization) from a set of oriented point clouds in R^3. It uses the generalized winding number framework to define an implicit surface. The implicit function returns a scalar value at each query point accounting for the number of turns of the underlying surface around that point. Thresholding this function defines an iso-surface approximating the exterior envelope.
summary: Generalized Winding Number Voxelization creates binary voxel grids from oriented point clouds by evaluating an implicit surface, bypassing the need for manifold meshes.
